text:
zoe: Heads up — found plaintext partner SA key in staging backup logs (gs://redwood-logs/staging/backups/2026-03-20/ingest.log). snippet: `AUTH: token=ya29.XXXX serviceAccount:partner-ingest-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` :rotating_light:
matt: ugh. thanks for flagging. can you paste exact object path and a couple surrounding lines?
zoe: full path above. nearby lines show repeated `GET /v1/backup` calls and a few > 10K lines with that token. pasted snippet: ```
2026-03-20T01:12:03Z INFO request user=svc:partner-ingest-sa token=ya29.XXXX path=/v1/backup
```
lina: I'll start the immediate containment checklist. priority: revoke the exposed SA key, disable any tokens, rotate KMS wrapping key for related backups, and kick off a Vault rewrap.
tia: For Vault+KMS-backed secrets, prefer rewrap over full rotation to minimize churn. proposed short plan: 1) disable SA key in GCP, 2) create new KMS key version (KEK), 3) re-wrap ciphertexts in object store with new KEK, 4) rotate Vault transit key (non-blocking) and rewrap internal transit-wrapped values.
jordan: Need RBAC for lina and zoe to run the GCP revoke and KMS ops. oncall, can you approve temp elevation?
oncall: Approved: `iam.admin` scope granted to lina and zoe until 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Ticket SEC-2026-789 created.
ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-789 and scheduled a rewrap job: job-id=rw-31415, targets=gs://redwood-logs/staging/backups/2026-03-20/*.cipher
lina: Running revoke now: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable 0f1a2b3c --iam-account=partner-ingest-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
matt: Also harvest any short-lived tokens issued using that SA (CI runners, cron jobs). check GitHub Actions runners and Dataflow templates.
tia: Rewrap snippet (run once after new KEK created): ```
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=my-keK --location=global --keyring=redwood-keystore
# rewrap object
kms_rewrap_tool --src=old_ciphertext --dst=gs://... --new-key=projects/.../keyVersions/2
```
zoe: I'm running an artifact search for plaintext tokens in backups, docker images, and uploads. already found two other objects referencing same token in `staging-app-uploads/2026-03-19/*.log`
jordan: Should we rotate Vault transit key now or after rewrap? consequence: rotating transit first will require re-encrypting all transit-wrapped values; doing rewrap at KMS layer first limits blast radius.
tia: Agree — do KMS rewrap first, then schedule Vault transit rotation as a follow-up maintenance window. update playbook to mark this as "kms-first" for KMS-backed artifacts.
lina: Revoke done. GCP reports key disabled. Running rewrap job (rw-31415) across 118 objects, batching 10 concurrently. ETA ~25m.
ops-bot: Rewrap job update: rw-31415: 10/118 complete, no failures. logs -> https://console.cloud.google.com/storage/browser/redwood-ops-logs/rw-31415/
matt: I've alerted the partners slack channel (p-partner-ingest) and opened an incident bridge. letting partner know code of conduct: rotate their side SA and check logs.
zoe: Post-cleanup checklist: - confirm no remaining plaintext exposures via full-text grep across backups - rotate any CI tokens that used that SA - schedule Vault transit rotation + announce maintenance window - add detection rule: alert on `token=` patterns in backups bucket - add DLP filter to block plain tokens during uploads
jordan: I'll take the DLP rule and detection alert. tia, can you own the Vault transit rotation timeline?
tia: Yep. propose non-peak window 2026-03-22 03:00-04:00 UTC. will send calendar invite.
lina: Rewrap finished: rw-31415: 118/118 complete. verified hashes and canary decrypt on 5 samples.
zoe: Verified partner SA key disabled, partner acknowledged and rotated their keys. closing incident when Vault transit rotation done. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
